actualCoverage.readMethod: Independently read every saved sourceText/Japanese pair in blocks 0–11, 12–23 and 24–34, title and all nine notes. Read the complete local Guiyou chapter at lines 5735–5887, with preceding ending and following heading checked. Reread changed passages. Style spot-checks, not full literary review, of published Japanese chapters 81–85: narrative openings, household address, narrator/dialogue distance and Bao-yu’s first-person voice.

changes.reason: Do not assert that eighteen is the verified stroke count of the ordinary traditional glyph. Both sources supply eighteen; preserve it and explicitly retain the unresolved glyph/count question.

checkedAndRetained: Reconciliation, the cut tassel, interwoven apology and intimate address, Daiyu’s feigned repudiation and shared tears retain speaker and sequence.
Baochai’s Yang Guifei/Yang Guozhong retort, the fan reprimand, Li Kui/Song Jiang play and Fengjie’s ginger joke preserve their different targets and indirect embarrassment.
Jinchuan’s warning gesture, Baoyu’s proposal, gold hairpin proverb, Wang Furen’s blow and expulsion, and narrator’s evaluation remain distinguishable; no exculpatory commentary added.

Lingguan’s identity remains unknown to Baoyu in the scene; flower-burial and poem-writing guesses remain his guesses, not narrator facts. East Shi allusion, repeated 薔 and shared rain-soaking retain the dramatic irony.

A hundred daily visits, tens of thousands of affectionate calls and thousands of 薔 retained despite smaller reference numbers. Eighteen strokes retained as source reading, not independently certified glyph count.
The twelve performers, female young-man role and main female role, bird-wing stitching, blocked drains and mistaken voice are preserved.
Baoyu’s intended attack on a junior maid, actual kick to Xiren, her shame and face-saving speech, bruising, cough and blood remain explicit; no modern medical diagnosis added.
Name forms and restrained narrative/dialogue register agree with sampled published chapters 81–85. Source blocks remain intact, including speech spanning blocks 4–5, 12–13, 19–20, 26–27 and 31–32.
